patthana15.5:1.1: hetuṃ saṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na saṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.5:2.1: na hetuṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na asaṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
